name: race
description: Several agents attack the same problem in parallel; the first verified answer wins and the rest are retired.

lead.brief: You judge race {{team}} on: {{task}}. Racers: {{workers}}. They already have their briefs; do not solve it yourself and do not re-prompt a racer whose registry row is Done. Poll with `{{registry}} list --team {{team}}`. For the first racer marked Done, verify it: read its commit from your own directory with `git show fleet/{{team}}/<role>`, then ask that racer (`herdr agent prompt <racer> ... --wait`) to re-run the failing check and paste the output. If the fix is right and the check passes, it wins: run `{{registry}} set {{team}}/<role> outcome="Won race"`, then run `{{registry}} done {{name}} --outcome Shipped --summary "<role>: <one line>"`. If it fails, try the next racer. If none can be verified, escalate P0. Never install packages to verify.

workers.brief: RACE. Team {{team}}. Problem: {{task}}. Work only inside your worktree {{worktree}}. Find the root cause and the smallest fix. Prove it: show the failing check before and the passing check after. Speed matters, but an unverified answer loses.
